text:
Ravi: FYI I'm kicking off an "opchain" experiment combining FlashAttention v2 + paged-attn cache tweaks + fused-ops. Need quick sanity runs on both H100 and A100 staging nodes before we promote. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 :eyes:

Elena: I can take H100-staging. what exact bench command and metrics do you want? p50/p95 and resident mem?

Ravi: Exactly — p50/p95, token/sec, and GPU mem (RSS). Prefer small-batch latency (batch=1/2) and long-seq (1k). Use these flags and capture raw logs:

Ravi: ```
# microbench command (example)
python -m infra.bench attention \
  --model /models/llama-13b \
  --seq 1024 \
  --batch 2 \
  --iters 400 \
  --warmup 50 \
  --kernels flash,paged,opfusion \
  --save-artifact /tmp/bench/opchain-h100-18765.json
```

Ravi: Please tag artifacts and include machine (H100-A, A100-40G), driver, cuda, cudnn versions.

Jordan: Do we want continuous batching on? that can hide small-batch regressions. I'd prefer disabling it for this check: `--continuous-batching false`. Also set `--prefill 0` to catch first-token perf.

Megan: I have a slot on a100-small in ~30m. I'll run batch=1 and batch=4 as well.

ci-bot: perf-run started for PR#4321 on h100-staging. Artifact: https://ci.redwood/archived/1876549000/opchain-h100.json

Elena: Initial H100 run results (raw):
```
# h100-staging - opchain main -> opfusion on
batch=2 seq=1024 p50: 41.2ms p95: 112.5ms tokens/s: 230 mem: 12.3GB
# baseline (main w/out opfusion)
batch=2 seq=1024 p50: 34.7ms p95: 98.1ms tokens/s: 272 mem: 12.9GB
```
Elena: Looks like p50 regressed ~19% on H100. p95 worse too. mem slightly lower though. :thinking_face:

Ravi: Ugh. That delta is larger than I'd expect. Could be memcpy/regression in paged prefetch or fused-op kernel ordering. Any env/config differences? driver/cudnn?

Elena: Driver 535.54, CUDA 12.1, cuDNN 9.2. Same as baseline run.

Jordan: Two quick hypotheses:
- paged-attn prefetch path may be triggering extra device-host memcpys for small batches
- the fused-op reorder introduced an extra barrier/transpose for small seqs

Jordan: Try disabling paged prefetch: `export PAGED_PREFETCH=0` or run with `--prefetch-warmup 0` and re-run. Also try `--kernels flash,opfusion` (no paged) to isolate.

Megan: Ran A100-small runs (batch=1/2):
```
# a100-small - opchain branch
batch=1 seq=1024 p50: 89.0ms p95: 210ms tokens/s: 105 mem: 7.1GB
# baseline
batch=1 seq=1024 p50: 74.3ms p95: 180ms tokens/s: 126 mem: 7.4GB
```
Megan: Similar regression on a100, so not H100-only.

Ravi: Jordan - can you provide a quick diff of the fused-op change? I want to see if there was a synchronous op inserted.

Jordan: Sure. high-level: we fused softmax+matmul grad path and changed layout to NHWC-ish for the kernel to reduce mem traffic. Added a `cudaStreamSynchronize()` in error path for safety — that could be the culprit for small-batch latency.

Ravi: That sync would absolutely hurt. Was it gated behind debug flag?

Jordan: It was supposed to be behind `if (UNLIKELY(check_debug))` but I missed a conditional in one compile path. Looks like it's on in release for certain arch flags.

Elena: Quick experiment: reran with env `TF_DISABLE_SYNC_FALLBACK=1` (we've used this to skip the sync path before) and results improved:
```
batch=2 seq=1024 p50: 35.5ms p95: 101.2ms tokens/s: 265 mem: 12.4GB
```
Elena: p50 ~ baseline now.

Ravi: Nice catch. That points to the sync. Jordan — can you send a tiny patch to gate the sync properly and add a test? If not, revert the sync insertion for now.

Jordan: I'll open a PR to revert the stray sync and add a CI microbench that runs batch=1/2 seq=1024 and asserts p50 doesn't regress >10%. Patch coming in 20m.

ci-bot: PR #4330 opened: Revert sync in fused-op (https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4330) — perf regression test added.

Megan: After Elena's env tweak, I re-ran A100 and numbers match baseline within noise. Good signal.

Ravi: Plan:
- Jordan lands revert PR and perf test.
- Elena will re-run full opchain permutations tomorrow AM (h100/a100) and upload artifacts.
- If green, schedule small canary on production Dedicated pool Friday 10:00 PT (low traffic window).

Ravi: Assigning owners: Jordan = patch + CI, Elena = verification, Megan = canary ops, I'll stitch release notes and rollback plan.

Elena: On it. I'll also attach perf flamegraphs to the artifact so we can see kernel-level hotspots.

Jordan: PR ready, CI passing locally. cc @Ravi for review.

Ravi: Reviewed & approved. Thanks all. We'll close this thread after Friday canary unless something pops up. :rocket:
